latestTerminalSummary:
Opus round 29 is a **FAIL**: 13 of 14 scores are 9, but Component visual consistency is 8.5 in both light and dark.

| Category | Light | Dark |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Typography | 9 | 9 |
| Composition and spacing | 9 | 9 |
| Color harmony | 9 | 9 |
| Contrast and emphasis | 9 | 9 |
| Component visual consistency | **8.5** | **8.5** |
| Responsive visual polish | 9 | 9 |
| Save discoverability and feedback | 9 | 9 |

**Why it's 8.5:** the empty and zero-result views use three different grammars:
- **Starred and Shared** put the whole instruction in one bold 16px block of text.
- **Search miss** uses a headline, a muted helper line and a button. This is the best of the set.
- **Search welcome** has only a 12px uppercase "Welcome to Exhibit" label above a 48px button. Every other main button here is 44px tall.

Two smaller points add to it:
- The Edit tag sheet's Save uses a check icon, while the header Save uses a floppy.
- The save-error message starts with a plain-text "✗" instead of an icon.

**Fix to earn 9:** give all four empty views one pattern: icon, short headline, muted helper line, then an optional 44px action. The welcome view needs a real headline or helper line. Use one Save icon everywhere and a proper warning icon in the error message.

**Empty fixture (the new required coverage):** the three empty views behave correctly in all 8 width/scheme pairs, with no horizontal overflow:
- Search welcome shows "Create your first artifact" (→ `/new`).
- Empty Starred shows "Browse your artifacts" (→ `/search`). The old Share guidance and self-link are gone.
- Empty Shared shows a neutral explanation with no action.

**Your three reported defects are fixed:**
- **Color check corner:** the badge now follows the cell's rounded corner cleanly. One new observation: on desktop the small cells let the badge cover about a quarter of the color dot. It looks intentional, but slightly crowded.
- **Tag spacing:** the tag label is compact, with its edit and remove buttons outside it (32px on desktop, 44px on phone).
- **Mobile Save:** it now shows the word "Save" at every width. Changing the title shows "Unsaved" with an active Save, and changing it back shows "Saved" with Save disabled, at all 8 width/scheme pairs. I never clicked Save. I didn't run a real save, error or retry myself; I looked at the parent's current-source screenshots for those states.

**Not inspected this round:**
- The source editor's Find/Replace/Go/completion and text selection.
- The expanded network, stored-data and versions panels.
- The Add and Settings pages, and the viewer menus.
- A few Share sheet size/scheme pairs.

Nothing was persisted. The title was restored, sheets were dismissed unchanged, the last reload showed Saved with Save disabled, and both of my tabs are closed. The report is the only file I wrote.

Report: `/home/maxomdal/.t3/worktrees/Exhibit/feature-Exh-zrjo-ui-council/docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo/round-29-opus-followup.md`
